## 1. Environment

Atlas 800T A2, single node 8 NPUs · Docker ≥ 24 · Python 3.12 · MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 · image `mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12` (must be imported into the local machine in advance)

## 2. Start Container

```bash
docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
docker exec -it mindspeed_llm bash
```

## 3. Code and Dependencies

```bash
git clone -b 26.2.0 https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
cd MindSpeed-LLM
git submodule update --init --recursive
git submodule update --init --remote 3rdparty/MindSpeed 3rdparty/FSDPTurbo
pip3 install -r requirements.txt
```

## 4. Weights

Download the Aquila-7B weights from Hugging Face and convert them to Megatron format:

```bash
bash examples/legacy/aquila/ckpt_convert_aquila_hf2legacy.sh
```

## 5. Data

```bash
bash examples/legacy/aquila/data_convert_aquila_pretrain.sh
```

## 6. Launch

```bash
bash examples/legacy/aquila/pretrain_aquila_7b_ptd.sh
```

## 7. Verification

```bash
bash examples/legacy/aquila/evaluate_aquila_7b_ptd.sh
```

ln -s 3rdparty/MindSpeed/mindspeed mindspeed
ln -s 3rdparty/FSDPTurbo/fsdp_turbo fsdp_turbo
ln -s 3rdparty/Megatron-LM/megatron megatron

pip3 install -r requirements.txt
mkdir logs

## 3. Weights

```

## 5. Launch

bash examples/legacy/aquila/pretrain_aquila_7b_ptd.sh

```

## 2. Start Container

Run this section on every node; the example maps only `davinci0`, so for 8 cards per node add `--device=/dev/davinci1` through `--device=/dev/davinci7` according to the output of `ll /dev/ | grep davinci`.

```bash
docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \

      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
docker exec -it mindspeed_llm bash
```

## 1. Environment

Atlas 800T A2 ×2 nodes, 8 cards each (16 total) · Docker ≥ 24 · Python 3.12 · MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 · image `mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12` (must be imported into the local machine in advance)

## 2. Start Container

Run this on every node. The example command mounts only `--device=/dev/davinci0`; add `--device=/dev/davinci1` through `--device=/dev/davinci7` according to the actual number of cards from `ll /dev/ | grep davinci`.

```bash
docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
docker exec -it mindspeed_llm bash
```

## 2. Pull the image
Both machines pull the same image.
```bash
docker pull swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-cann9.1.0-mindspore2.10.0-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12

## 3. Start the container
Start one container on each node. Only card 0 is mounted by default, add `--device=/dev/davinci1:rwm` through `--device=/dev/davinci7:rwm` for the actual cards.
```bash
docker run -itd \
  --ipc=host \
  --network=host \
  --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci_manager:rwm \
  --device=/dev/devmm_svm:rwm \
  --device=/dev/hisi_hdc:rwm \
  -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
  -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
  -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
  --name mf-telechat336b \
  swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-cann9.1.0-mindspore2.10.0-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
  /bin/bash
docker exec -it mf-telechat336b bash
```

## 4. Code and dependencies
The image already includes MindSpore Transformers, MindSpore and CANN; for the r2.0.0 release code install from source in the container and it is ready once the self-check prints `All checks passed`:
```bash
git clone -b r2.0.0 https://atomgit.com/mindspore/mindformers.git
cd mindformers
python -c "import mindformers as mf;mf.run_check()"
```

## 5. Data
Pretraining dataset WikiText-103: convert `wiki.train.tokens` to jsonl first (one record per line, with `src`/`text`/`type`/`id`/`title`), then to Megatron binary; `--tokenizer-dir` points to the TeleChat3-36B tokenizer directory:
```shell
python toolkit/data_preprocess/megatron/preprocess_indexed_dataset.py \
  --input /path/to/data.jsonl \
  --output-prefix /path/to/wiki103-megatron \
  --tokenizer-type HuggingFaceTokenizer \
  --tokenizer-dir /path/to/TeleChat3-36B
```

## 6. Weights
Download the model weights, tokenizer and config from `TeleAI/TeleChat3-36B-Thinking` on ModelScope; pretraining from scratch needs no weights.

## 7. Launch
In `configs/telechat3/pretrain_telechat3_36b.yaml` set the parallelism to `data_parallel: 1`, `model_parallel: 8`, `pipeline_stage: 2`, `micro_batch_num: 4`, `use_seq_parallel: True`. Run on both machines, below is node 0; on node 1 change `node_rank` to 1 and set `master_ip` to the IP of Rank 0:
```shell
master_ip=192.168.1.1
node_rank=0
port=50001
bash scripts/msrun_launcher.sh "run_mindformer.py \
--config configs/telechat3/pretrain_telechat3_36b.yaml \
--auto_trans_ckpt False \
--use_parallel True \
--run_mode train" \
16 8 $master_ip $port $node_rank output/msrun_log False 7200
```

## 8. Verify
Logs are in `output/msrun_log/worker_0.log`; training is normal when `step` increases, `loss` decreases and `grad_norm` stays finite; with pipeline parallelism only the last stage shows the real loss, checkpoints are stored in `./output/checkpoint`.

## 1. Environment

Atlas 800T A2 ×2 nodes, 8 cards each (16 total) · Python 3.12 · MindSpore ≥ 2.10 · CANN, driver and firmware must match the chosen MindSpore; install the NPU driver and firmware on the host first.

## 2. Install dependencies

Install MindFormers and HyperParallel (required for dynamic-graph training):

```bash
git clone -b master https://atomgit.com/mindspore/mindformers.git
cd mindformers
bash build.sh
```

```bash
cd ..  # currently in ~/mindformers, go back to the home directory before cloning
git clone https://atomgit.com/mindspore/hyper-parallel.git
cd hyper-parallel
python setup.py bdist_wheel
pip install dist/hyper_parallel-*-py3-none-any.whl
```

Run the environment self-check; it is ready once it prints `All checks passed`:

```bash
python -c "import mindformers as mf;mf.run_check()"
```

## 3. Data

First convert `wiki.train.tokens` yourself into jsonl with `src`/`text` per line; replace `/path/to` with the data directory and the tokenizer directory (put `/path/to/TeleChat3-36B`), producing `_text_document.bin/.idx`:

```bash
cd ..  # currently in ~/hyper-parallel, go up one level from the clone directory
cd mindformers
python toolkit/data_preprocess/megatron/preprocess_indexed_dataset.py \
  --input /path/to/data.jsonl \
  --output-prefix /path/to/wiki103-megatron \
  --tokenizer-type HuggingFaceTokenizer \
  --tokenizer-dir /path/to/TeleChat3-36B # other model sizes can use their own tokenizer path
```

## 4. Launch

Fill `data_path` in the yaml with `/path/to/wiki103-megatron_text_document` (no suffix); run once on each machine and set `node_rank` to 1 on node 1:

```bash
master_ip=192.168.1.1
node_rank=0
port=50001
bash scripts/msrun_launcher.sh "run_mindformer.py \
--config configs/telechat3/pretrain_telechat3_36b.yaml \
--auto_trans_ckpt False \
--use_parallel True \
--run_mode train" \
16 8 $master_ip $port $node_rank output/msrun_log False 7200
```

## 5. Verify

Logs are in `./output/msrun_log`; with pipeline parallelism the real loss only appears in the last pipeline stage log, and ckpts are saved to `./output/checkpoint`:

```bash
